name: Turtle Tale
description:
Distribution of this software ended at 10:00 on Wednesday, October 10, 2018.

----------------------------------------------
Take back Turtle Island after it was invaded by pirates! In this somewhat nostalgic side-scrolling action game, control Turtle Island's No. 1 hero ``Sheldon'' and fight off the terrifying ``Captain O'Hare Pirates.''

Shoot the powerful water gun like a shotgun and defeat the many enemies that appear one after another.

There are three stages in each of the five areas: beach, forest, cave, jungle, and sky, and the final stage after conquering the area is a battle with a boss. Plus, there are 15 additional bonus stages to unlock!

Now, enjoy simple controls, colorful graphics, catchy music, and sound effects as you set off to reclaim Kameshima!
